title: AI route with an image
prompt: Add POST /notes/from-image to src/routes/notes.ts. The body is { "imageUrl": string } (a URL). Send the image to the "fast" AI model alias and ask it to read the photographed note, getting back a title (at most 200 characters) and a body as structured output. Create a note owned by the current user with that title and body and return it with status 201. Track AI usage for the user.
